pictures.name: card
pictures.prompt: A battered little retro take-away diner at night seen from the street, warm glowing window, a faded red and white striped awning, a completely blank shop sign with no writing, a brown paper take-away bag and a paper order ticket on the front counter, at most one grotesque caricature human cook with a huge red nose and a tall white chef's hat working behind the window, no other people, no customers, nobody in the street, a rough brushy deep-blue evening sky, wide landscape picture for a title card, the diner in the middle.

pictures.name: back-diner
pictures.prompt: An empty worn retro diner interior after closing time, seen straight on from the customer side: a long bare pale counter across the bottom, a big plain cream wall in the middle with a few shelves of jars and plates near the edges, a round wall clock, checkered tiles at the very top edge, the middle of the wall bare and calm so things placed on top stand out. Deserted, still, only furniture and objects, wide landscape.
